name: PLC_connection
info:
Establishes a connection with the SmartUnity PLC.

Accepts and sends packets over the SmartUnity protocol.

### Inputs

: payload (string) : Packets to PLC

`Note!` To convert data to SmartUnity protocol, use node **To_SmartUnity**.

### Outputs

: payload (string) : Packets from PLC

`Note!` To convert data from SmartUnity protocol, use node **From_SmartUnity**.

### Configuration

IP-address of PLC with SmartUnity core.

`format:` **xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx**
